notes.title: VERSION 0.9.1.21 - Big balance change, Outdated Tech Filter and other stuff
notes.notes:
Hi guys! Here is a new version for you:

[b]0.9.1.21:[/b]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You have a filter option on the Hardware Design Screen to filter outdated technology - so you won't have to memorize what is the best - but still you, have the option to use earlier tech in your hardware.
[*] Steam Save Cloud enabled
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can create 20 building sites
[*] The AI is even slower now than before. But it is really dependent on difficulty.
[*] AI will survive for much longer.
[*] The DPP of the world is greatly reduced. Probably most of you will have financial problems with older saved games, unfortunately. The best thing what you can do is to reduce the factory and laboratory budgets to survive in those games. You will have to expand your market size faster in new games.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes/Other modifications:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hardware and Computer list screens had several problems with the ordering features - fixed.
[*] The Statistic graphs had issues with dates - fixed
[*] In the Main Menu "Load" is changed to "Load Game".
[*] Some scrollbars were buggy, so they were always "full". - Fixed
[*] After Version 0.9.1.20 Radio Marketing checkboxes didn't work - fixed, and also I removed prestige as an option there.
[*] I changed the name of "device sizes" such as "5.25-inch" into "5.25-inch bay" to make it more straightforward that it is a size standardization, not an exact device.
[*] "Operating System" type fixed on the Hardware List Screen
[/list]


I know guys, I know... the game is harder now. Don't worry if it will be too much for you, I will make it a bit easier and also I will create more difficulty levels soon.
The game at the start will be a bit slower later because I plan to create a state where you have much more restrictions what you can do - you will start in a garage next to a simple family house. The tutorial will use this time to teach you some stuff. Don't worry also, it won't be a really long thing, maybe some years.
I will probably start a new discussion, focusing on the GUI, because you gave me a lot of great feedback so far. I have 57 tasks in my to-do list that doesn't contain yet the features that I'd like to add to the base game. This is very cool, thank you! I'm always trying to prioritize.

[b]Please support me on my Steam Page and in the Discussions as well just as you did so far! You are an amazing community! I'm very thankful guys![/b]

Your friend,
Andris

[*] I've added a lot of resolutions for the game including 1024x768 and even 4K. Please let me know if your resolution still has any problems - unfortunately, I cannot test all of them myself, I have only full HD monitors.
[*] Zip driver is repositioned in the tech line to a correct timing
[*] From now on you can freely rename hardware and computers even after putting them on the market.
[*] The save list won't show the game settings file anymore
[*] The price setter and name setter windows will show the actual data, not the last typed
[*] The in-game menu won't appear after closing it and going back in the menus.
[/list]

The game is much harder now. If you will need, I will make it easier on the beginner level, also I plan to create more difficulty levels.

Soon I will make the computer players last a bit longer and add some more stuff into the simulation, while I still have a LOT of work with bugs and the GUI. I will do my best as always. 

Thanks for your support with the bugs I really appreciate it! Also thanks for the support on the game's store page. I really need your help, you are great!
We are back in "positive" now. I'm very happy about that!


Your friend,
Andris

Your friend,

notes.title: VERSION 0.9.1.15 - is here!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, after taking care stuff around my company and making a trip to my dentist and also luckily feeling better than last time I've made a new version for you during this night!

0.9.1.15:

- I've created a design select window that will appear before creating a new hardware. This way people won't forget to choose a design, and also they won't be confused about the "first you have to choose a design" message.
-If you create a new hardware starting originally from the hardware menu/hardware list (not from starting a new computer design), when you finished with the new hardware and you go back to the hardware list, the hardware list filters will be updated by the new hardware's design and type - so you will surely see it in the hardware list.
- If you'd like to create a new computer you first select the design of the computer. No change. But after that when you select the desired hardware into the computer, the hardware list will be filtered by the computer's design, and the type of the hardware automatically.
- Also, if you don't have a hardware in the list to put into the computer, by pushing the "new" button, the hardware window won't ask for the computer design (neither the old way, and neither by the new design select window), but it will be automatically selected.
- I'm not sure about this point, but I tried to solve the negative customer number in the upper info bar. I've given a much bigger number type for it that should fix the problem (if that was the problem). Please let me know if you see the negative customer number again!

Also, I tried a totally new saving technology to speed up the saving process, but it seems that I already use the fastest solution. My only way to speed up the process is to reduce the saved data. I will do my best in that because I saw that many of you have way too much loading times resulting in a barely useable saving system. I'm aware of that

Also, I'm very thankful for the reports! You are awesome, keep them coming! Thank you very much! Thanks for the support on the store page as well, the game really needs it.

Let me know in the discussions if you like the update.

Andris

notes.title: VERSION 0.9.1.12 - is here!
notes.notes:
Hi all, new version, new bug fixes. Here is the brief list:

0.9.1.12

- Issue after getting no sales after having handheld computers (but not having portable computers) is fixed
- Self-testing and ALS aren't unresearchable anymore.
- Nerfed the up and downclocking options meaning that you cannot get negative results now.
- Internet and Game promotion marketing tools are back
- Changed the recreation upkeep costs
- You cannot build more than 7 building sites anymore
- Mute music works again
- Put down the focus option from given buttons, so now you won't press for example the "Market!" button again accidentally by pressing the SPACE button on your keyboard
- Typing names and number values won't affect the time speed anymore
- You don't have to click on the "you have not enough manufacturing power" message anymore. It will disappear automatically. 
- Now when you try to add a non-compatible hardware to a computer, it will tell on the list screen that you can't do it, so you don't have to reopen everything.

AND

I altered the research screen. I added a more detailed list. Now you can read the values from the lines (such as performance or RP value and so on). Next time I will add the opportunity to order and filter this list on a given level.

I utterly failed to reproduce the bug when you type into the computer name box and the focus goes away, again and again, making it very hard to write a name into it. On my side, I just cannot do that somehow. Please give me tips in the "Official Bug Thread" (not here please).

I'd like to say THANK YOU again, you are already a living and very helpful community, I really enjoy working for YOU!

Still, I have a lot to do. I will try to do my best. In this first two weeks, I will try to eliminate everything that could stop you enjoying the game.

For those who cannot load saved games, please be patient. It takes time. The reason is that at this moment the game stores a LOT of data. Specifically, that where, when, who, what (with all computer data), in what amount did sell anything and anytime back to the game start - and it is also a bit redundant to make the game running faster during playtime.
After some years this is a really huge amount of data ~60Mb serialized.

Keep sending me the bugs and I will hunt them down, always write date and version, and if you can send me a save file. Having a save file can reduce a 1-hour long task into a 10 mins task.

You are awesome,
Andris

notes.title: VERSION 0.9.1.11 - is here!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I'm sorry for the bugs guys! In the last 19 hours, I've been working without a stop and I made a lot of bug fixes and a bit more. Because I want you to be sure that I will do my best and I hear you. Here is a brief list:

0.9.1.11:

- You can choose from 6 different pointers
- Increased loading speed at opening (some had issues there, please update the thread!)
- Computer names won't disappear
- I've modified the "sold number" on the product to whole numbers
- Now you can archive your computers
- I fixed a late-game manufacturing error 
- I've modified the dominancy map to show the country as yours even if you didn't sell yet anything, but there are no opponents (also for them as well)
- You can set voice/music/fx volumes
-Settings windows is available during play - also the game will remember your settings of course
- No more problem with closing windows/overlaps
- Fixed the bug that shows you +/-100 downclock/downgrade possibility on the hardware screen instead of the real 15%
- Corrected some typos
- From now on the map will highlight a country with all of its smaller parts (such as islands)


AND also I made you a DPP counter. This will tell you the "demanded production power" so you will know what's going on when the lady tells - "you muthafucka don't have enough manufacturing capacity!" :)

- if you have blue screens, please update your video card/chipset/etc drivers. As Cliffski said often, that's the number #1 reason for those. And update the threads after that.

I hope this will make it much better for YOU! I have much more things to do, don't worry I was never a lazy guy! :) The 90% of the game was made in the last 5 months. 
Maybe this is frightening, but honestly, I didn't have the opportunity for a longer project and/or to keep back the release, the reports that you give help me tremendously! 
My savings are enough to keep it up until my birthday 2017 February, and that's it, but this was really a dream of mine to make it happen. Please help me by spreading the word, that's all that I hope for.

I have much more things to fix and do, I know! I read you!

Have fun! See you soon again between the discussions.

THANKS for your support!
